t: Sheyyeezor motnayv vikasseh rosho bishat tepilla
s: Sheyyeezor motnayv vikasseh rosho bishat tepilla ubo v' seipim: begadayv ketzad? En tzarik lomar shettehe ervato mekussa velo yehe libbo roeh et haerva, ella apillu im hayeta tallit chagura lo al motnayv lekassoto mimmotnayv ulematta, vechotzetz betallito al motnayv shello yehe libbo roeh et haerva — asur lehitpallel ad sheyyekasseh libbo, mittaam shennitbaer siman a"d. Veim lo kissa et libbo, o shenneenas veen lo bemah sheyyitkasseh, hoil vekissa ervato vehitpallel — yatza:

Tzarik leezor ezor bishat hattepilla apillu im yesh lo abnet sheen libbo roeh et haerva, mishshum shenneemar: "hikkon liqrat eloheka yisrael". Abal bishar berakot muttar lebarek belo chagora, meachar sheyyesh lo abnet bammiknasayim veen libbo roeh et haerva. Vehu haddin apillu belo miknasayim im begadayv munnachim mammash al bitno vechotzetzim ben libbo laerva. Umi sheholek kol hayyom belo chagora — en tzarik leezor bishat tepilla:

Asur lehotzi azkara mippiv berosh megulleh. Veyesh omerim sheyyesh limchot shello likkanes lebet hakkeneset begilluy harosh. Umiddat chasidut hu shello lelek d' ammot begilluy harosh apillu shello bebet hakkeneset, kemo shennitbaer besiman b':

Kobaim haqqeluim miqqash chashubim kissuy, abal hannachat yado al rosho enah chashuba kissuy, lepi shehayyad veharosh gup echad hen veen haggup yakol lekassot et atzmo. Abal im acher manniach yado al rosho — yesh lehaqel (kevan sherash"l meqel legamre):

Lo yaamod adam bitpilla baapuneddato, velo beraglayim megullim im derek anshe hammaqom shello yaamdu lipne haggedolim ella bebatte raglayim. Abal im darkam laamod yechepim bipne haggedolim kemo beeretz haarab — muttar lehitpallel yachep. Ubimdinot ellu en lehitpallel bebatte shoqayim shel pishtan im lo yilbash alehem anpilaot (sheqqorin zaqy"n), sheggenay hu laamod bipne haggedolim bebatte shoqayim shel pishtan bilbad, umikkol shekken keshennoalin sandal (sheqqorin pantapy"l) sheheaqeb megulleh (abal beanpilaot muttar lehitpallel ap belo batte shoqayim, meachar sheyyesh lo ezor lehapsiq ben libbo laerva, o shebbegadayv munnachim mammash al bitno, kemo shennitbaer besaip b'). Veken en lilbosh bishat hattepilla batte yadayim kederek obere derakim:

Derek hachakamim vetalmidehem shello yitpallelu ella keshehen atupim. Uminhag hachakamim harishonim keshehaya shalom baolam hayu mitqashshetim bibgadim naim umitpalelim, mishshum "hikkon ku'", kelomar hitnaeh lepanayv. Ubeet hazzaam hayu omedim keebed lipne rabbo shemmashlik addarto mealayv shello yeraeh kechashub, vechobeq et yadayv beetzbeotayv meemat rabbo veyirato, dehaynu shechobeq etzbeotayv shel yadayv zeh beshel zeh keadam sheshshober etzbeotayv keshemmitztaer. Veyesh mehachakamim shehayu osim ken ap beet shalom. Umikkol maqom, tob lizzaher shello lechabbeq etzbeotayv beet shalom, ki bazeh morid din al atzmo, ella yanniach yadayv zeh al zeh keputin, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tz"h:
